title: Flags, documented
description:
Combine and decode flag values the way Win32 documents them.

```
flags 0x00C00000 = WS_CAPTION (WS_BORDER | WS_DLGFRAME)
flags 0x10CF0000 = WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE
unknown bits: 0x00000001
```
hints: A flag is present when `(flags & f.value) == f.value`; testing only `flags & f.value` would wrongly match half of a combined flag (lesson 3.04).
Remove each matched value with `flags &= ~f.value` so it is not named twice.
requirements: A table of a few window style values, including combined ones like `WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW`.
`describe(flags)` names the largest combined flags first, then single ones, then shows leftover bits.
The values are copied from the documentation page (they are listed there).
stretch: Parse a text like `"WS_CAPTION | WS_VISIBLE"` back into a number.
